Spectacle FX restore-on-exit contract

nodes.label: WindowTweaks.ahk
nodes.rationale: Entry point only: process directives, #Include manifest, one Boot() call; no globals or functions.

nodes.label: Boot()
nodes.rationale: Single ordered startup sequence; no module may contain a top-level call, so everything that must run at startup lives here (ordering hazards had already produced two real bugs).

nodes.label: Bye()
nodes.rationale: Single teardown; also the tray Restart path. Calls WriteSettings/FlushLog directly because there is no idle on the way out; stops every polling timer and private FX loop.

nodes.label: SnapCore.ahk
nodes.rationale: Pure geometry and window predicates with no side effects.

nodes.label: SnapAxis()
nodes.rationale: Each axis snaps independently; lines moved away from are penalised, flush lines win ties by hyst px.

nodes.label: GetRects()
nodes.rationale: Returns both DWM extended frame bounds and WinGetPos rect; ignoring the invisible border makes every snap land ~7px off.

nodes.label: IsCloaked()
nodes.rationale: DWMWA_CLOAKED filters UWP-suspended and other-virtual-desktop windows that WS_VISIBLE does not catch.

nodes.label: RenderCore.ahk
nodes.rationale: The only place allowed to call WinSetTransparent/SetWindowPos/WinMove/WinSetRegion/WinSetExStyle; features queue desired state, priorities arbitrate within one flush.

nodes.label: RS_Pos
nodes.rationale: Pending request map, not state; w/h -1 means SWP_NOSIZE. Window positions are deliberately not cached because the user moves windows behind the pipeline.

nodes.label: RS_AlphaState
nodes.rationale: Persistent per-window composed opacity: final = base * product(layers); replaced last-writer-wins absolute writes that destroyed user-set transparency.

nodes.label: RS_RecomposeAlpha()
nodes.rationale: Emits Off (strip WS_EX_LAYERED) only for a structurally neutral record (base 255, zero layers), never because arithmetic rounded to 255.

nodes.label: RS_RemoveHwnd()
nodes.rationale: Must be called when a touched window is destroyed; overlay GUIs raise no shell destroy notification so every destroy site calls it, RS_SweepDead is the backstop.

nodes.label: RS_Flush()
nodes.rationale: Re-entrancy guarded because timers call it directly while the frame loop may be inside it.

nodes.label: AnimationScheduler.ahk
nodes.rationale: One 15 ms timer multiplexing every animation; 15 not 16 because the ~15.6 ms clock tick made 16 alternate 15.6/31.2 ms.

nodes.label: StopScheduler()
nodes.rationale: Re-checks ActiveAnimations.Count and refuses to stop while work is queued, closing a race with an interrupting RegisterAnimation.

nodes.label: RenderFrame()
nodes.rationale: Produce (call every registered callback over a snapshot of keys) then RS_Flush exactly once.

nodes.label: Anim_Claim()
nodes.rationale: Channel registry (geom/alpha/region) giving one animation sole ownership; replaced five drifted hand-maintained CancelAnimation lists.

nodes.label: MediaCore.ahk
nodes.rationale: WASAPI detection of audio/video-playing windows so they are never faded; kept free of QPC/RegisterAnimation/WriteLog so a test harness can include it alone.

nodes.label: MC_AnyMedia()
nodes.rationale: O(1) gate to hoist out of per-window loops.

nodes.label: FeatureFlags.ahk
nodes.rationale: Declared default of every boolean/string/enum setting plus enum lists; first in the manifest.

nodes.label: TuningRegistry.ahk
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for every user-tunable number; load, clamp, persist and UI are generated from TUNE_SPEC.

nodes.label: TUNE_SPEC
nodes.rationale: One row per tunable number; replaced ranges repeated in three drifting places. lo is lowest usable value; step is documentation not quantisation.

nodes.label: TUNE_VAL
nodes.rationale: Named TUNE_VAL not TUNE because identifiers are case-insensitive and would collide with Tune().

nodes.label: SyncTuningGlobals()
nodes.rationale: Mirrors rows backing long-standing globals (SNAP_DISTANCE etc.) so hot read sites pay no Map lookup; TUNE_VAL is authoritative.

nodes.label: WriteLog()
nodes.rationale: Buffered in RAM and flushed by an idle one-shot; FileAppend costs 1.9-9.3 ms and must never run on an input path.

nodes.label: IniPick()
nodes.rationale: Enumerated settings validated by membership, not range, so DropDownList.Choose never throws inside BuildWin.

nodes.label: SaveSettings()
nodes.rationale: Debounces to an idle one-shot WriteSettings; IniWrite is ~770 us per key.

nodes.label: WriteSettings()
nodes.rationale: Diffs against IniCache; brackets body with Game Mode unsuspend/resuspend so the overlay never reaches settings.ini.

nodes.label: ScreenMetrics()
nodes.rationale: Caches monitor rects and virtual-screen bounds, invalidated by WM_DISPLAYCHANGE; work areas are read live because auto-hide changes them silently.

nodes.label: OverlayGui.ahk
nodes.rationale: One lifecycle for every transient overlay.

nodes.label: GuiDestroy()
nodes.rationale: Destroy rather than WinClose so the Gui object does not leak; pairs with RS_RemoveHwnd.

nodes.label: SettingsWindow.ahk
nodes.rationale: Sidebar-nav settings GUI; sole owner of C, Win, Pages, NavItems, CurPage. Pages scroll with no scrollbar, so UpdatePageHint is the affordance; add settings groups as pages, not rows.

nodes.label: BuildWin()
nodes.rationale: Builds pages declaratively from the nav list; every Edit/DropDownList gets both EDITBG and EDITFG because BackColor never reaches Edit text. DropDowns are built from the same enum lists IniPick validates against.

nodes.label: UpdatePageHint()
nodes.rationale: Flips the sidebar hint to 'Scroll for more settings' when the page is taller than the client area; settings below the fold read as missing features.

nodes.label: ApplyUi()
nodes.rationale: writeBack=false on the debounced Change path so a field is not rewritten while the user is typing; LoseFocus/close pass true. Assume-global, hence ui*/ep* scratch prefixes. Calls every Sync* so flags actually start/stop timers.

nodes.label: SyncTray()
nodes.rationale: Tray labels (with embedded tab+hotkey) are the lookup key for tick marks; renaming a label without updating every site silently breaks the checkmarks.

nodes.label: ToggleFeatureFlag()
nodes.rationale: Shared path for feature toggles: flip, persist, update checkbox, notify, play hotkey sound - so tray, settings and hotkey behave identically.

nodes.label: Shift+Alt+o
nodes.rationale: Always-on-top declared inline, far from the hotkey block; self-excludes by PID so it cannot pin its own GUI.

nodes.label: InputBindings.ahk
nodes.rationale: The hotkey block: every global hotkey is Shift+Alt+<key> and delegates to a named function the tray also binds, so behaviour never drifts. Opens/closes with bare #HotIf because #HotIf bleeds across #Include.

nodes.label: Shift+Alt+Numpad7
nodes.rationale: Keypad tiles are bound only under digit names; with NumLock off the gesture is dead (Shift+Alt+Up/Down are the NumLock-independent aliases).

nodes.label: IsDoublePress()
nodes.rationale: A repeated modifier release is not enough: Ctrl+C then Ctrl+V looked like a double-tap and opened Spotlight. Rejects if a non-modifier key was pressed in between; blocks triple-press double firing.

nodes.label: UpdateKeyboardHook()
nodes.rationale: Calls KeyOpt('{All}','N') because InputHook.OnKeyDown fires only for keys with the Notify option; without it keystroke sounds only fired on a handful of keys.

nodes.label: ApplyLayout()
nodes.rationale: Single funnel for keyboard layout: RS_Commit (one-shot producer), frame-space to WinMove-space conversion, releases the geom channel so a live glide cannot overwrite the move, clears roll-up region.

nodes.label: ToggleMaximize()
nodes.rationale: Deliberate exception to ApplyLayout: uses WinMaximize/WinRestore and cannot gate on IsRestorable, which rejects maximized windows.

nodes.label: MorphMaximize()
nodes.rationale: Runs after the OS state change: RS_* has no maximize state, so the window is genuinely maximized and only its rect is animated on the geom channel; skipped when glide is off.

nodes.label: ChangeTransparency()
nodes.rationale: Writes the base alpha via RS_SetBaseAlpha so ambient layers compose on top instead of clobbering the user's choice; notification debounced through FlushTransNotify (one toast per gesture, not per notch).

nodes.label: AltDragMove()
nodes.rationale: Samples on a Sleep(10) cadence and measures its own elapsed time so velocity is px/s like the title-bar drag; shares ParallaxAlpha with the drag pipeline.

nodes.label: AskWindowIcon()
nodes.rationale: Uses SendMessageTimeout with SMTO_ABORTIFHUNG: a hung foreign window would otherwise freeze the whole process.

nodes.label: RestoreAllWindows()
nodes.rationale: Recovery path for state the user cannot see: unroll, un-ghost, un-hide, un-bottom, reset composed alpha, curtains and shatters.

nodes.label: GameMode.ahk
nodes.rationale: Game Mode suppression is an in-memory overlay that must never reach settings.ini.

nodes.label: GAME_MODE_FEATURES
nodes.rationale: The only copy of the suspended-feature list; two copies (one per direction) drifted, suppressing features that never came back.

nodes.label: EnterGameMode()
nodes.rationale: Flushes settings BEFORE touching any flag so a power cut mid-session cannot persist the overlay. Loops are assume-global because %name% := resolves to a local otherwise.

nodes.label: GameModeUnsuspendForWrite()
nodes.rationale: WriteSettings brackets its body with unsuspend/resuspend in try/finally so the file records the real configuration, not the overlay.

nodes.label: DragPipeline.ahk
nodes.rationale: Hooks MOVESIZESTART/END instead of the mouse; MOVESIZEEND fires after the OS modal move loop, the only safe moment to reposition. Callbacks are not in fast mode because they query windows, register animations and arm timers.

nodes.label: ParallaxAlpha()
nodes.rationale: Names both ends of the ramp (parallaxfrom/parallaxfull) because a gain-calibrated ramp was invisible at normal drag speed; both drag paths call this one function so they cannot drift.

nodes.label: ReadDragFullWindows()
nodes.rationale: Defaults to on when the query fails - the harmless guess.

nodes.label: CheckDragFullWindows()
nodes.rationale: DragFullWindows is a hard dependency of every drag effect and its absence is silent, so it is enabled at boot rather than merely warned about.

nodes.label: SampleVelocityStep()
nodes.rationale: Velocity is px/s with a time-constant EMA so consumers are frame-rate independent.

nodes.label: FinishDrag()
nodes.rationale: Deferred 50ms from the hook because it enumerates windows and must not run inside the hook callback.

nodes.label: DropPlacement.ahk
nodes.rationale: Two coordinate spaces (DWM extended frame bounds vs WinMove) cost ~7px per snap if confused; snap reach scales with release speed so slow moves can park near edges.

nodes.label: OnSnapLanded()
nodes.rationale: Called from Glide's final frame (or directly without glide), never from a timer racing the animation.

nodes.label: VerifySnap()
nodes.rationale: Nudges apps that reposition after a drag, but never while our own glide owns the geom channel.

nodes.label: Glide()
nodes.rationale: Elapsed-time quintic ease-out; returns its duration so verification can be scheduled after landing.

nodes.label: MoveFast()
nodes.rationale: Cheaper than WinMove per frame and leaves z-order/focus alone; delegates to the render pipeline.

nodes.label: KeepOnScreen()
nodes.rationale: A throw must not fling a window off into nowhere.

nodes.label: WindowClassification.ahk
nodes.rationale: Classifies main application windows (WMI-backed); classification belongs on the window-created path, never the drag path.

nodes.label: PositionMemory.ahk
nodes.rationale: window-positions.ini writes are buffered in PendingPositions and flushed by a 900ms one-shot because IniWrite costs ~770us and must never run on an input path.

nodes.label: RememberPosition()
nodes.rationale: Does not call IsMainApplicationWindow because that reaches a WMI query - too slow for the drag path.

nodes.label: WindowOpenAnim.ahk
nodes.rationale: Animates brand-new windows in; WillAnimateOpen is the single eligibility test applied before hiding a window, so foreign windows are never made layered speculatively.

nodes.label: ShellHook.ahk
nodes.rationale: New windows detected via RegisterShellHookWindow, not polling; registration does not survive an Explorer restart so TaskbarCreated re-registers. Registered last in Boot() because ShellEvent is the widest-reaching callback.

nodes.label: AmbientDimming.ahk
nodes.rationale: Opacity on a foreign window is composed, never absolute: breathing installs a named 'breathe' alpha layer and never touches the user's base alpha.

nodes.label: SyncBreathingTimers()
nodes.rationale: Timers used to be installed unconditionally; WinGetList+IsRestorable per tick cost too much for a disabled feature.

nodes.label: BreathingMonitorStep()
nodes.rationale: Runs on a 200ms timer; a throw would kill the timer for the session, so it is defensive.

nodes.label: MC_Tick()
nodes.rationale: MediaCore takes the clock as a parameter to stay include-safe, so this timer wrapper reads QPC.

nodes.label: ScreenEdgeGestures.ahk
nodes.rationale: Both features are polling monitors (SetTimer with Sync*) and must call RS_Commit themselves. Cursor wrap is an intent model with speed, dwell and cooldown gates, not a threshold test.

nodes.label: CursorWrapMonitorStep()
nodes.rationale: Only wraps when the user clearly meant it: approach speed sampled before contact, dwell, and cooldown gates; suppressed while dragging.

nodes.label: FocusEmphasis.ahk
nodes.rationale: A monitor is a SetTimer, never a RegisterAnimation - an always-true animation pinned the 15ms frame loop and timeBeginPeriod(1) for the whole session.

nodes.label: AcousticKeystrokes.ahk
nodes.rationale: Synthesised RIFF/WAVE clicks (noise transient + damped low sine) replaced GM-percussion MIDI that sounded like a drum kit; bank rendered off the input path by a one-shot from SyncKeySounds; playback purged before buffers are freed.

nodes.label: AK_VoiceForKey()
nodes.rationale: Returns empty (deliberate silence) for c/x/v while clipboard feedback hotkeys are active, mirroring the #HotIf contexts in InputBindings, so Ctrl+C does not click twice.

nodes.label: AK_IsRepeat()
nodes.rationale: Auto-repeat gate is 'is this key already down', not a repeat-rate guess.

nodes.label: AK_KeyReleased()
nodes.rationale: Map.Delete throws on a missing key; key-ups arrive without key-downs, so every Delete is guarded with Has().

nodes.label: AK_BuildBank()
nodes.rationale: Publishes new bank, purges playback, then releases the old bank, so a mid-typing re-render never frees a buffer winmm is reading; plays one sample click when a level changes so the setting is audible.

nodes.label: AudioOsd.ahk
nodes.rationale: One animation key per window per effect (OsdFade_) so in/out fades cancel each other; auto-hide uses negative SetTimer, never a scheduler countdown; region/alpha set before Gui.Show().

nodes.label: HideVolumeOSD()
nodes.rationale: Auto-hide via negative SetTimer rather than a scheduler countdown.

nodes.label: OnDemandOverlays.ahk
nodes.rationale: Quick Look, Spotlight and the magnifier share a lifetime: built on demand, own the screen until dismissed, must leave nothing behind; RS_RemoveHwnd on destroy because tool windows raise no shell destroy notification.

nodes.label: ToggleSpotlight()
nodes.rationale: Region and alpha set before Show(); otherwise the launcher flashed a grey rectangle on every launch.

nodes.label: PinnedWindowModes.ahk
nodes.rationale: Modes that leave a foreign window in a state the user cannot undo by hand (PiP, always-on-bottom, ghost), so Bye() must restore them; cross-process SetParent only undone by RestoreFromBottom; never SendMessage to a foreign window without a timeout.

nodes.label: RestoreFromBottom()
nodes.rationale: Mandatory exit-time restoration for cross-process SetParent to WorkerW.

nodes.label: ToggleGhostMode()
nodes.rationale: Installs its alpha layer at factor 1.0 so RenderCore never strips WS_EX_LAYERED on a rounding to 255 while the cursor rests on a ghost.

nodes.label: MouseGestureFx.ahk
nodes.rationale: Grouped by what drives the effect (pointer motion/idle/wheel); animations parameterised on elapsed time; every polling timer has a Sync* and Bye() stops it; overlays built lazily.

nodes.label: InitShakeFind()
nodes.rationale: Built lazily on first use; deliberately not called at startup.

nodes.label: SyncShakeDetector()
nodes.rationale: ShakeDetector was armed unconditionally at load; now a Sync* so a disabled feature costs nothing.

nodes.label: SyncCursorFxTimer()
nodes.rationale: CheckMouseIdle was armed unconditionally; now gated by its flag.

nodes.label: HideSmoothCaret()
nodes.rationale: Single hide path every caller goes through.

nodes.label: SmoothCaretWatchdog()
nodes.rationale: An overlay an animation shows must not be hidden only by that animation; 250 ms watchdog takes the caret down when it vanishes, focus changes or the flag goes false.

nodes.label: ShellSurfaceWatcher.ahk
nodes.rationale: The ONE poll over Explorer's surfaces: smart auto-hide, taskbar icon wave and elastic toasts share one 32 ms CheckTaskbarAndUI timer because CheckToasts enumerates every top-level window per tick. Work areas are never cached because auto-hide changes them without WM_DISPLAYCHANGE.

nodes.label: RenderTaskbarWave()
nodes.rationale: The model shape: tests its own flag first so it can always clean up its overlay.

nodes.label: CheckTaskbarAndUI()
nodes.rationale: Calls RenderTaskbarWave unconditionally so the sub-check can tear down its overlay when its flag goes false; gating the call site stranded overlays.

nodes.label: SyncTaskbarUiTimer()
nodes.rationale: Replaced an unconditionally armed 32 ms timer; every polling timer needs a Sync* that Bye() can stop.

nodes.label: TaskbarClock.ahk
nodes.rationale: The only network egress. Block may never intersect TrayNotifyWnd; draws nothing rather than guessing if the anchor is missing. Default ON is safe only because a blank location makes no request.

nodes.label: ResolveClockAnchor()
nodes.rationale: Anchor is a setting (TrayEdge vs Clock), resolved by class name every tick; there are no coordinates anywhere.

nodes.label: FindTrayElement()
nodes.rationale: Uses FindWindowExW at both levels and returns 0; ControlGetHwnd with a bare class name throws inside the timer and killed the feature.

nodes.label: SampleTaskbarColor()
nodes.rationale: Block painted in the taskbar's own colour, never colour-keyed: keying fringed ClearType glyph edges with the key colour. Samples left of the block so it never samples itself.

nodes.label: FetchWeather()
nodes.rationale: Returns immediately when clockweather is off or location empty; open-meteo over async WinHttp polled with WaitForResponse(0) so nothing blocks.

nodes.label: WeatherFailed()
nodes.rationale: Triples retry interval up to 15 minutes rather than retrying into a rate limit.

nodes.label: RestoreCurtain()
nodes.rationale: CurtainWindows is the only record of where windows came from; Bye() must call this or exiting mid-effect leaves the desktop swept clean.

nodes.label: FxGravity.ahk
nodes.rationale: Window spectacle FX: one-shot desktop takeovers; bindings gated in #HotIf so Windows' own Alt+F4 / Win+D run when off. Show the bitmap copy before hiding the original.

nodes.label: RestoreShatters()
nodes.rationale: Called by Bye() and RestoreAllWindows so a mid-effect exit puts shattered windows back.

nodes.label: ToggleStealthPanic()
nodes.rationale: Refreshes settings on the way IN only; mute flags must still hold their captured meaning on the way out.

nodes.label: StealthCall()
nodes.rationale: StealthPanic runs hosted and standalone; a direct call to a missing function is a LOAD-time error no try catches, so %name% is resolved at runtime and failures swallowed.

nodes.label: StealthSyncFeatures()
nodes.rationale: Flipping flags without calling Sync* leaves timers and overlays alive; ghost and PiP need explicit teardown since no Sync* releases them.

nodes.label: StealthPanicConfig.ahk
nodes.rationale: Safe-app list lives in a UTF-8 BOM sidecar, not the ini: IniWrite/IniRead truncate at newline, strip quotes and leave orphan lines. Nothing here may throw (runs from a top-level initialiser).

nodes.label: StealthPanicConfig_WriteFileAtomic()
nodes.rationale: Temp-then-MoveFileExW write so a failed write is never data loss.

nodes.label: StealthPanicConfig_MigrateToSidecar()
nodes.rationale: Purges ini stores only after the sidecar is written and read back.

nodes.label: StealthPanicConfig_ReadAppList()
nodes.rationale: Checks sidecar -> [SafeApps] -> legacy applist -> default; legacy last on purpose, checking it first collapsed the list on every reopen.

nodes.label: StealthPanicUI.ahk
nodes.rationale: Separate process; takes the ini path as argument 1 so GUI and engine cannot edit different files.

nodes.label: SaveSettings()
nodes.rationale: Name collides with the main app's SaveSettings; harmless only while the processes are separate.

nodes.label: Defensive Code & Edge-Case Handling
nodes.rationale: Anticipate nulls, missing handles and bounds errors; fail gracefully via try/catch instead of crashing.

nodes.label: Simple and Robust Logic
nodes.rationale: Readable, stable code beats clever fragile code; small single-responsibility functions.

nodes.label: Non-Destructive Integration
nodes.rationale: New features isolated and modular, minimal interference with core architecture and hooks.

nodes.label: Analyze Before Implementing
nodes.rationale: Understand problem, architecture and execution flow, find root cause and compare solutions before writing code; never assume project structure.

nodes.label: SOLID / DRY / Separation of Concerns
nodes.rationale: Enterprise-grade maintainability: layered/clean architecture, reuse, no duplicated logic.

nodes.label: Self Code Review Before Completion
nodes.rationale: Check duplicate logic, dead code, architecture violations, performance and null safety before finishing.

nodes.label: Single Shift+Alt Hotkey Chord
nodes.rationale: Commit 3dadac4 collapsed the Win+Ctrl tier into Shift+Alt because Win+Ctrl chords collided with Windows-reserved and accessibility shortcuts.

nodes.label: Stale Win+Ctrl Tray Labels
nodes.rationale: Tray label strings are the SyncTray lookup key, so renaming requires updating every Add/Check/Uncheck site together; labels still show pre-3dadac4 chords.

nodes.label: Keypad Tiling Dead With NumLock Off
nodes.rationale: Only Numpad digit names are bound; navigation names (NumpadHome etc.) are not.
nodes.norm_label: keypad tiling dead with numlock off

nodes.label: Magnetic Snapping
nodes.rationale: Reach scales with release speed so slow drags can park near an edge; hysteresis and corner boost.

nodes.label: Ice Glide
nodes.rationale: Quintic ease-out slide after release, elapsed-time driven, with settle overshoot.

nodes.label: Position Memory
nodes.rationale: Keyed on exe_class; buffered writes so input paths never touch disk; classification (WMI) kept off the drag path.

nodes.label: Infinite Cursor Wrap Intent Model
nodes.rationale: Speed, dwell and cooldown gates all required, because the desktop outer edge is touched constantly; speed sampled before contact since clamped pointer speed is zero.

nodes.label: Opacity-Only Effects Taste Constraint
nodes.rationale: Owner wants opacity effects; pulse, neon, 3D carousel, depth of field and blur were deleted and must not return. Ripple Click kept.

nodes.label: Keyboard Window Layout via ApplyLayout
nodes.rationale: ApplyLayout is the single place that commits, converts frame to WinMove space, cancels competing animations and clears roll-up region.

nodes.label: Morph Maximize
nodes.rationale: Runs after the OS state change because RS_* has no maximize concept; animates rect on the geom channel.

nodes.label: Tuning Registry (TUNE_SPEC)
nodes.rationale: One row per tunable number replaces three drifting copies of each range; lo is lowest usable value; step is documentation not quantisation.

nodes.label: Enum Settings Validated by Membership
nodes.rationale: DropDownList.Choose on an unlisted value throws inside BuildWin, killing the settings hotkey; IniPick validates against the same list the control uses.

nodes.label: Module Include Contract (no top-level calls)
nodes.rationale: Every module holds definitions and global initialisers only; startup runs in Boot() to remove file-order hazards that had caused two bugs.

nodes.label: Coupling by Shared Globals
nodes.rationale: Deliberate; assignment to undeclared name creates a local, hence assume-global ApplyUi/LoadSettings with ui*/ep* prefixes.

nodes.label: Architecture Rules (ownership, SSOT, layering)
nodes.rationale: Clear ownership over file count; no Utils/Helpers modules; dependencies flow input->feature->services->infrastructure->Win32.

nodes.label: Flat src/ and No-Underscore Filename Rule
nodes.rationale: Setup.cs unflattens '_' to '\' on extract, so an underscore filename breaks only installed copies.
nodes.norm_label: flat src/ and no-underscore filename rule

nodes.label: #HotIf Is Positional and Bleeds Across Includes
nodes.norm_label: #hotif is positional and bleeds across includes

nodes.label: Top-Level Global Is Super-Global
nodes.rationale: Duplicate declarations raise no error and the later include wins.

nodes.label: Render Pipeline (RenderCore queue + flush)
nodes.rationale: Features queue desired state; only RenderCore touches window position/alpha/region/z-order; priorities arbitrate within a flush.

nodes.label: Composed Opacity (base x layers)
nodes.rationale: Absolute alpha writes were last-writer-wins and wiped the user's transparency; final = base * product(layers), one owner per layer name.

nodes.label: Off Only for Structurally Neutral Alpha Record
nodes.rationale: Stripping WS_EX_LAYERED on arithmetic 255 would toggle the style 40x/s under a resting ghost.
nodes.norm_label: off only for structurally neutral alpha record

nodes.label: One-Shot Producers Must RS_Commit
nodes.rationale: Scheduler stops when idle so an unflushed queue is never applied; this silently killed snapping-without-glide, transparency wheel and more.

nodes.label: Window Positions Deliberately Not Cached
nodes.rationale: User drags change positions behind the pipeline; caching made a repeat snap a no-op.

nodes.label: Never Read Pending RS Maps as State
nodes.norm_label: never read pending rs maps as state

nodes.label: 15 ms Frame Period
nodes.rationale: Windows tick is ~15.6 ms; 16 ms deadlines alternate 15.6/31.2 ms. Measured 62.8 fps / 0.37 ms jitter at 15 vs 39.8 fps at 16. Needs timeBeginPeriod(1).

nodes.label: Parameterise Animation on Elapsed Time
nodes.rationale: Fixed per-frame steps ran in slow motion under load (659 ms instead of 416 ms).

nodes.label: Velocity in Pixels per Second
nodes.rationale: SampleVelocityStep ignored dt so all consumers were calibrated to a 15 ms frame; now time-constant smoothing.

nodes.label: Drag Parallax Endpoint-Calibrated Ramp
nodes.rationale: A gain-based ramp was invisible at normal speeds; ParallaxAlpha names both ends as settings.

nodes.label: Animation Channel Ownership (geom/alpha/region)
nodes.rationale: Replaced five drifting CancelAnimation lists; Map keys enumerate sorted so same-priority animators silently lost.

nodes.label: Measured Operation Costs
nodes.rationale: FileAppend and IniWrite dominate (ms), window queries are sub-microsecond; never touch disk on input paths.

nodes.label: Never Touch Disk on an Input Path
nodes.rationale: One drag spent 30 ms in FileAppend and one toggle 31 ms in IniWrite; logging and settings now buffered and idle-flushed.
nodes.norm_label: never touch disk on an input path

nodes.label: Every Polling Timer Needs a Sync* and Bye() Stop
nodes.rationale: Three timers ran forever regardless of flags; a monitor registered as an animation pinned the frame loop.
nodes.norm_label: every polling timer needs a sync* and bye() stop

nodes.label: Flag Test Inside Overlay Teardown
nodes.rationale: Gating at call site stranded three overlays on screen after features were disabled.

nodes.label: Drag Pipeline Flow
nodes.rationale: MOVESIZESTART/END hook -> SampleVelocityStep -> FinishDrag (deferred 50 ms) -> SnapWindow -> Glide -> VerifySnap; nothing may block.

nodes.label: Low-Level Mouse Hook Trade-off
nodes.rationale: ~LButton was originally rejected (~1.6% idle CPU) but mouse hotkeys now exist; per-event work reduced instead.

nodes.label: Synthesised Keystroke and Hotkey Sounds
nodes.rationale: Replaced GM MIDI percussion that sounded like a drum kit; WAV synthesised in memory, separate typing and action volumes.

nodes.label: Purge Playback Before Freeing Sound Buffer
nodes.rationale: SND_ASYNC means winmm still reads the buffer; rebuild publishes, purges, then releases.
nodes.norm_label: purge playback before freeing sound buffer

nodes.label: Two Coordinate Spaces (DWM frame vs WinGetPos)
nodes.rationale: Ignoring the invisible DWM border makes every snap land ~7 px off.
nodes.norm_label: two coordinate spaces (dwm frame vs wingetpos)

nodes.label: SendMessage Only With Timeout
nodes.rationale: A hung foreign window would freeze the whole process.

nodes.label: Stealth Panic Mode
nodes.rationale: Bolt-on that also runs standalone; missing functions resolved at runtime via StealthCall because direct calls are load-time errors.

nodes.label: Safe-App List Sidecar File
nodes.rationale: IniRead stops at first newline and strips quotes; list moved to StealthPanicApps.txt and legacy key checked last.

nodes.label: Game Mode
nodes.rationale: In-memory suppression overlay; WriteSettings brackets with unsuspend/resuspend so suppression never persists; single GAME_MODE_FEATURES list.

nodes.label: Custom Taskbar Clock
nodes.rationale: Only network egress; positioned by class-name anchor and font width, never coordinates; nothing requested until a city is set.

nodes.label: Clock Anchor Setting (TrayEdge vs Clock)
nodes.rationale: TrayEdge moves with icon count; Clock anchor covers Control Center button.

nodes.label: Paint Taskbar Colour Instead of Colour-Keying
nodes.rationale: ClearType edges blend with the key colour and halo; taskbar is one flat colour (0x202020).
nodes.norm_label: paint taskbar colour instead of colour-keying

nodes.label: Overlay Must Forward WM_CLOSE to ExitApp
nodes.rationale: Permanent overlay absorbed WM_CLOSE so Bye never ran and settings.ini was truncated.
nodes.norm_label: overlay must forward wm_close to exitapp

nodes.label: open-meteo over Async WinHttp
nodes.rationale: MSXML returned empty JSON bodies and wttr.in served HTML landing pages at 200; async polling never blocks.

nodes.label: Inputs Need Both Background and Text Colour
nodes.norm_label: inputs need both background and text colour

nodes.label: Overlay Shown by Animation Needs a Watchdog
nodes.rationale: Smooth caret stayed on screen after its glide unregistered; SmoothCaretWatchdog pattern.
nodes.norm_label: overlay shown by animation needs a watchdog

nodes.label: Settings Window Scroll Affordance
nodes.rationale: No scrollbar, so off-screen settings looked missing; UpdatePageHint shows 'Scroll for more settings'; add groups as pages.

nodes.label: Packaging (Install.ps1 + Setup.cs)
nodes.rationale: Two installers must stay in sync; payload globbed from src/*.ahk; Setup.cs is C# 5.

nodes.label: Pure ASCII No-BOM .ahk Source
nodes.rationale: BOM-less files read in system codepage turn smart quotes into mojibake.

nodes.label: ExitApp-Prepended Parse Check
nodes.rationale: AHK 2.0 has no /validate; prepend ExitApp and run with /ErrorStdOut.

nodes.label: DragFullWindows Hard Dependency
nodes.rationale: Outline dragging means rect never moves until release, so velocity is zero and glide/parallax silently do nothing; CheckDragFullWindows enables it at boot.

nodes.label: Windows Snap Assist Wins at Screen Edges
nodes.norm_label: windows snap assist wins at screen edges

nodes.label: Linux Qt6 Port (linux/)
nodes.rationale: Independent scaffold sharing only design (render arbitration, animation scheduler); does not build.

nodes.label: Check-Split.ps1 Structural Checks
nodes.rationale: Only safety net: parse, motion proof hash, HotIf bracketing, case clashes, hotkeys, no top-level calls.

nodes.label: Motion Proof Hash
nodes.rationale: Hashes sorted code lines of the resolved include stream; pure code motion must be byte-identical; re-anchor with -Baseline in the same commit.

nodes.label: Gui Lifetime Must Cover Its Animation
nodes.norm_label: gui lifetime must cover its animation

nodes.label: No Administrator Rights Required
nodes.rationale: Everything installs per-user and writes HKCU only.

nodes.label: Shadow-like Effects Disabled by Default
nodes.rationale: Defaults flipped in FeatureFlags and IniStr fallbacks so fresh installs start off while existing settings.ini values are preserved.

nodes.label: Note: Never Write Tests Into Project
nodes.rationale: One-line instruction against adding test files to the project.
nodes.norm_label: note: never write tests into project

nodes.label: Windows Animation Settings for Window Tweaks
nodes.norm_label: windows animation settings for window tweaks

nodes.label: Show Window Contents While Dragging (required)
nodes.rationale: Only setting genuinely required; without it the ice glide is invisible.

nodes.label: Recommended Animation Settings (MinAnimate, TaskbarAnimations, UserPreferencesMask)
nodes.rationale: Makes the rest of the system move at the same quality so the glide does not stand out.

nodes.label: Windows Snap Assist Conflict
nodes.rationale: Snap Assist acts before Window Tweaks sees the release; recommendation is to leave it on since window-to-window magnetism still works.

nodes.label: Deliberately Not Recommended Tweaks
nodes.rationale: 'Adjust for best performance' turns off DragFullWindows and breaks the glide.

nodes.label: Feature-Gated #HotIf Hotkeys
nodes.rationale: Key stays free for the active app until the feature is enabled.

nodes.label: Windows Shortcuts Overridden / Untouched
nodes.rationale: Only Shift+Alt+S (Speech Recognition) is claimed; accessibility Win+Ctrl chords deliberately untouched.

nodes.label: Hotkeys Delegate to Named Functions
nodes.rationale: Tray, settings window and hotkey share one function so behaviour cannot drift.

nodes.label: Motion First, Converge Second
nodes.rationale: Each phase pure code motion with zero behaviour delta; convergence fixes land as separately revertable Phase 11 commits.

nodes.label: Phase 1 Boot Extraction
nodes.rationale: Top-level initialisers ran in file order and clobbered state set by earlier Sync* calls; Boot() removes the hazard.

nodes.label: SettingsControlSet() C[] Decoupling
nodes.rationale: Only place outside BuildWin that touches C; no-op when settings window closed.

nodes.label: FEATURE_SPEC (boolean/string sibling of TUNE_SPEC)
nodes.rationale: Getter/setter closure pairs so typos are load errors; collapses three-way manual mirror of boolean settings. Deliberately not built yet.

nodes.label: TEARDOWN_SPEC (data-driven Bye)
nodes.rationale: Three phases: stop producing, hand back foreign state, destroy own Guis. Not built; Bye moved unchanged.

nodes.label: Pre-split Symptoms (god functions, 59 render violations, 8 shell-class lists)
nodes.norm_label: pre-split symptoms (god functions, 59 render violations, 8 shell-class lists)

nodes.label: Installers Hardcoded .ahk List
nodes.rationale: A module missing from the list fails only on installed copies, so de-hardcoding was Phase 0.

nodes.label: Taskbar Shrink Dead Ends (TaskbarSi, TaskbarSmallIcons, flags)
nodes.rationale: Measured on build 26200 so nobody retries them.
nodes.norm_label: taskbar shrink dead ends (taskbarsi, taskbarsmallicons, flags)

nodes.label: ExplorerPatcher Integration
nodes.rationale: Only real way to shrink the taskbar; opt-in, with dxgi.dll / EDR quarantine risk and documented rollback.

nodes.label: Resource Use (~18 MB, shell hook not polling)
nodes.rationale: Shell hook replaced enumerating every window ~86x/minute.
nodes.norm_label: resource use (~18 mb, shell hook not polling)

nodes.label: Main Finding: Premium Feel Was Switched Off
nodes.rationale: Fix was turning animations/transparency back on via SystemParametersInfo rather than hand-editing UserPreferencesMask.
nodes.norm_label: main finding: premium feel was switched off

nodes.label: What Was Not Done (power mode, HAGS)
nodes.rationale: Domain policy and hardware blocked them; HKCU-only, no admin.
nodes.norm_label: what was not done (power mode, hags)

nodes.label: HKCU-Only Reversible Tuning with Backup
nodes.rationale: Prior values saved to tuning-backup.json and restored by Restore-Windows-Tuning.ps1.

nodes.label: Rejected roadmap effects (Lightsaber Glow, Privacy Blur, Carousel, Motion Blur, Depth of Field, Spark Typing, Slide-Up Blur)
nodes.norm_label: rejected roadmap effects (lightsaber glow, privacy blur, carousel, motion blur, depth of field, spark typing, slide-up blur)

nodes.label: tweaksd daemon
nodes.rationale: C++20/Qt6 daemon reproducing the Windows tray utility's window management on Linux; computes state, backends apply it.

nodes.label: Early scaffold status (does not manage windows)
nodes.rationale: Earlier docs claimed completion; warnings now head every doc and no completion claim may be added without pointing at backing code.
nodes.norm_label: early scaffold status (does not manage windows)

nodes.label: core -> PlatformAdapter -> backend dependency flow
nodes.rationale: core/ is platform-independent and the only place geometry and physics live; a backend applies state, never computes it.

nodes.label: Composed opacity (base x named layers)
nodes.rationale: Absolute alpha writes let one feature clearing transparency destroy another's opacity; ported from Windows RS_AlphaState. One owner per layer name: drag, ghost, breathe, depth, open, gravity.

nodes.label: Per-window animation channel ownership (claim/release/owner)
nodes.rationale: Replaced drifting hand-written cancel lists on Windows; prevents two animations driving the same property of the same window.

nodes.label: removeWindow eviction on window death
nodes.rationale: Without it a recycled window id inherits a stranger's opacity.

nodes.label: Structural alpha off for neutral record
nodes.rationale: Off is emitted only when base 1.0 and zero layers, not when a product rounds to 1.0; on X11 this deletes _NET_WM_WINDOW_OPACITY rather than setting 0xFFFFFFFF.
nodes.norm_label: structural alpha off for neutral record

nodes.label: Swap-and-release flush pattern
nodes.rationale: Ported from RS_Apply: pending map swapped under lock and applied outside it so a blocking backend cannot stall producers.

nodes.label: D-Bus contract org.tweakforeveryone.Daemon
nodes.rationale: Duplicated in DBusDaemon.h (authoritative) and extension.js; generating all copies from one definition is the better fix. One-way: signals only, daemon to extension.

nodes.label: Wayland strategy: compute in daemon, apply via compositor extension
nodes.rationale: A Wayland client cannot move other windows, set opacity, read the pointer or grab keys.
nodes.norm_label: wayland strategy: compute in daemon, apply via compositor extension

nodes.label: Refusal to bypass Wayland security
nodes.rationale: No LD_PRELOAD, root /dev/input reads, or accessibility API abuse; unsupported features are documented, not hacked in.

nodes.label: 16 ms frame period (vs 15 ms on Windows)
nodes.rationale: Windows 15 ms is a measured compensation for the ~15.6 ms timer tick; do not harmonise without measuring on Linux.
nodes.norm_label: 16 ms frame period (vs 15 ms on windows)

nodes.label: KDE requires a compiled KWin plugin
nodes.rationale: The KWin JS scripting API cannot receive D-Bus signals, so a script could never be driven by the daemon.
nodes.norm_label: kde requires a compiled kwin plugin

nodes.label: Cinnamon extension requirement
nodes.rationale: Panel/actor-level features (taskbar clock, wave) are unreachable from a plain X11 client.

nodes.label: install.sh must stay LF
nodes.rationale: CRLF shebang fails only at runtime on Linux.

nodes.label: GNOME 45 ESM extension API break
nodes.rationale: metadata.json claims 42-46 while code uses ESM, 45+ only.

nodes.label: Quintic ease-out sign fix
nodes.rationale: Old expression returned 2.0 at t=0; kept struck-through so nobody reverts the sign.

nodes.label: Plasma 6 tooling rename (kpackagetool6/qdbus6)
nodes.rationale: install.sh detects both names to serve Plasma 5 and 6.

nodes.label: Velocity in px/s with time-constant smoothing
nodes.rationale: Shared with Windows: throw gain 0.18 px per px/s; smoothing 1-exp(-dt/tau), never per-frame ratios.
nodes.norm_label: velocity in px/s with time-constant smoothing

nodes.label: XCB via pkg_check_modules
nodes.rationale: CMake ships no FindXCB.cmake; every xcb component ships a .pc file, a vendored finder would drift.

nodes.label: CMake does not expand ~
nodes.rationale: install DESTINATION ~/... created a literal ~ dir; per-user files belong to install.sh.

nodes.label: TweakUI target removed
nodes.rationale: Named non-existent src/ui sources, causing configure failure; Gui/Widgets dropped until sources exist.

nodes.label: Threads::Threads link requirement
nodes.rationale: AnimationScheduler's std::thread fails to link on some toolchains without it.

nodes.label: Headless core unit tests (no FetchContent)
nodes.rationale: Tree must configure with no network on a fresh Mint box; TestHarness.h is 60 lines instead of Catch2.

nodes.label: check_layers structural test
nodes.rationale: Bash-based Check-Split.ps1 analogue wired into ctest.

nodes.label: Common Core + Platform Adapters
nodes.rationale: Linux is fragmented across X11/Wayland and GNOME/KDE/Cinnamon.

nodes.label: Central Render Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Prevents features fighting over window state: feature -> desired state -> RenderQueue priority -> arbitration -> flush -> adapter.

nodes.label: Render priorities ambient < animation < drag < user
nodes.norm_label: render priorities ambient < animation < drag < user

nodes.label: ConfigParser tuning registry (planned)
nodes.rationale: Not implemented; tunables are literals at use sites.

nodes.label: Weather end-to-end path
nodes.rationale: WeatherFetcher -> DBusDaemon WeatherUpdated -> extension.js panel label; the only feature wired end to end.

nodes.label: Shift+Alt single-chord hotkey scheme
nodes.rationale: Ctrl+Alt tier removed in Windows commit 3dadac4 due to collisions with reserved chords.

nodes.label: 34-feature x 5-environment matrix
nodes.rationale: All rows Planned; marks describe intended mechanism.

nodes.label: Implement against Cinnamon/X11 first
nodes.rationale: X11 backend needs no compositor cooperation; shortest path to a working feature.

nodes.label: What done would require roadmap
nodes.rationale: X11Adapter, window enumeration, config parser, drag velocity capture, KWin/GNOME extensions, settings UI+SNI tray.

nodes.label: Absent-not-empty directory check
nodes.rationale: git does not track empty dirs so find -type d -empty returns nothing and reads as a pass.

nodes.label: supports(Capability) honest backend query
nodes.rationale: A plausible fake rect (old 800x600) is worse than empty because it feeds snapping real-looking numbers.

nodes.label: Wayland client sandbox constraints
nodes.rationale: Clients don't know absolute position, can't alter other windows, can't intercept global input.
